about.title: San Fernando Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: San Fernando is a compact, busy city inside Los Angeles County, with families, workers, and small businesses relying on everyday products — from kitchen appliances to power tools to vehicle parts sold along corridors like San Fernando Road and Glenoaks Boulevard. When a product fails because of a flaw in its design, a mistake in manufacturing, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can upend daily life fast. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a claim under strict liability, meaning you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused harm. We handle product liability cases for San Fernando residents on contingency, evaluating your claim at no upfront cost. If a defective product hurt you, the first step is simple: hold onto the item, and let our team review what happened.
commonInjuries: Burns from malfunctioning appliances or batteries
Lacerations from faulty tools or machinery
Traumatic injuries from failed vehicle components
Poisoning or illness from mislabeled products
Crush or amputation injuries from equipment defects
Fall injuries caused by structurally unsound products

whyChoose.title: Why San Fernando Residents Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Under California law, you generally don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that the product was defective and caused your injury. Our team can help identify which type of defect applies to your situation.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable for a defective product. That means there may be more than one avenue for pursuing accountability.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because these claims often hinge on physical evidence, keeping the defective item intact and unaltered can be important. We can advise you on how to protect that evidence properly.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California generally applies strict liability to product defect cases, so the focus is on whether the product itself was defective and caused your injury, not on proving carelessness. Our team can walk you through how this applies to your specific case.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me here in San Fernando?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, without repairing, discarding, or altering it. This physical evidence is often central to product liability claims. Store it somewhere safe and let us review it as soon as possible.

items.question: Is there a cost to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our initial consultation is free, and we typically handle product liability cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward after speaking with us.

items.question: Can a retailer be responsible, or only the manufacturer?
items.answer: Under California law, liability can extend beyond the manufacturer to distributors and retailers who sold the defective product. Our team can help determine which parties may be involved in your particular case.
